reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on their #north-team message. I said I'd noted they're on the road tomorrow morning (Thursday 15 Oct) and reachable on mobile.

I checked their calendar first, and they have nothing booked tomorrow, so there was nothing to move. I offered to block the morning as "travelling" so nobody books them, but I'll only do that if they ask. Nothing else was needed: the message was just a status update.
